usage: agentbreeder cluster [-h] {up,status,down} ...

positional arguments:
  {up,status,down}
    up              Create the cluster and registry, and add them to the
                    stack's grant
    status          Show the cluster, the registry and the tools they need
    down            Delete the cluster and registry (refused while something
                    is deployed there)

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit
